author: mario86
quote: Cyberpunk 2077  A F**king Masterpiece! 10/10**Holy ****, what a game! Cyberpunk 2077 is an absolute masterpiece and easily one of the greatest RPGs ever made. Night City is **** breathtaking, the atmosphere is unmatched, and the storytelling hits harder than almost anything else in modern **** characters are unforgettable, the quests are brilliantly written, and the freedom to approach combat however you want is incredible. The graphics, especially with path tracing enabled, are absolutely mind-blowing. This game looks like it's from the **** let's not forget Phantom Liberty, a phenomenal expansion that takes an already incredible experience to another **** Projekt RED deserves massive respect for turning Cyberpunk 2077 into something truly extraordinary. The transformation since launch has been nothing short of incredible.This isn't just another open-world game. It's a living, breathing dystopian nightmare that completely pulls you in and refuses to let go.**Forget the haters. Cyberpunk 2077 is a **** work of art, a technical masterpiece, and an unforgettable experience. An easy 10/10. Absolutely legendary!

author: mario86
quote: Crimson Desert  An Absolute Masterpiece! 10/10**Holy ****, what an incredible game! Crimson Desert is everything modern gaming should be. A breathtaking open world, absolutely stunning graphics, fantastic combat, and an insane amount of freedom. This is what happens when developers actually give a damn about making a great game instead of chasing trends and pushing pointless **** attention to detail is ridiculous. Every corner of the world feels alive, exploration is genuinely rewarding, and the combat is some of the most satisfying I've experienced in years. The sheer scale and ambition of this game put many so-called AAA titles to shame.Pearl Abyss has delivered something truly special. No soulless corporate ****, just pure adventure, creativity, and outstanding gameplay.I haven't been this impressed by a game in a very long time. Crimson Desert reminds me why I fell in love with gaming in the first **** absolute triumph. A masterpiece that deserves every bit of praise it gets. Easily one of the best games I've ever played. 10/10!

author: mario86
quote: GTA 6  An Overhyped, Bug-Ridden, Woke Disaster | 1/10**What an absolute  disappointment. After years of hype, billions of dollars, and endless promises, Rockstar somehow managed to deliver a bloated, buggy, politically correct mess that feels more interested in pushing woke nonsense than actually being a great Grand Theft Auto **** technical issues are infuriating, the gameplay feels uninspired, and the whole experience reeks of corporate greed. Instead of the rebellious, controversial, unapologetic GTA we used to love, we get something that feels painfully sanitized and desperate to avoid offending anyone.Where is the Rockstar that used to mock absolutely everyone? Where is the dark humour, the attitude, the creativity?GTA 6 feels like a soulless corporate product wearing the skin of a legendary franchise. Years of waiting for this? What a **** joke.Massive hype. Massive disappointment. An absolute embarrassment. 1/10.
